function.name: get_all_blog_posts
function.description: Read a page of CMS blog posts. Filtering: Use propertyName__operator format (e.g., state__eq=PUBLISHED, slug__contains=marketing). Supported properties: id, slug, campaign, state, publishDate, name, archivedAt, createdById, updatedById, blogAuthorId, translatedFromId, contentGroupId, tagId. Supported operators: eq, ne, contains, icontains, startswith, in, nin, lt, lte, gt, gte, is_null, not_null, like, not_like. Publish state: Use state__eq with DRAFT, SCHEDULED, or PUBLISHED.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to return. Default is 20.

after.description: The cursor token value to get the next set of results. You can get this from the paging.next.after JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

archived.description: Specifies whether to return deleted blog posts. Defaults to false.

sort.description: Specifies which fields to use for sorting results. Valid fields are createdAt (default), name, updatedAt, createdBy, updatedBy.

createdAt.description: Only return blog posts created at exactly the specified time.

createdAfter.description: Only return blog posts created after the specified time.

createdBefore.description: Only return blog posts created before the specified time.

updatedAt.description: Only return blog posts last updated at exactly the specified time.

updatedAfter.description: Only return blog posts last updated after the specified time.

updatedBefore.description: Only return blog posts last updated before the specified time.

function.name: create_blog_post
function.description: Create a new CMS blog post. All fields are at the top level per HubSpot API v3 specification. Required fields: name, contentGroupId, slug, blogAuthorId, metaDescription, postBody. If useFeaturedImage is true, featuredImage must be provided.

language.description: Language code (ISO 639-1 with optional country code, e.g., 'en', 'es', 'en-US', 'pt-BR')

enableLayoutStylesheets.description: Boolean to determine whether or not the styles from the template should be applied

metaDescription.description: A description that goes in <meta> tag on the page

attachedStylesheets.description: List of stylesheets to attach to this blog post

password.description: Set this to create a password protected page

htmlTitle.description: The HTML title of the post

publishImmediately.description: Set this to true if you want to be published immediately when the schedule publish endpoint is called

id.description: The unique ID of the blog post

state.description: An enumeration describing the current publish state of the post

slug.description: The URL slug of the blog post

createdById.description: The ID of the user that created the post

rssBody.description: The contents of the RSS body for this Blog Post

archivedInDashboard.description: If True, the post will not show up in your dashboard

contentTypeCategory.description: An ENUM describing the type of this object. Should always be BLOG_POST (0)

updatedById.description: The ID of the user that updated the post

translatedFromId.description: ID of the primary blog post that this post was translated from

widgetContainers.description: A data structure containing the data for all the modules inside the containers for this post

featuredImage.description: The featuredImage of this Blog Post

authorName.description: The name of the blog author associated with the post

domain.description: The domain that the post lives on

name.description: The internal name of the post

dynamicPageHubDbTableId.description: For dynamic HubDB pages, the ID of the HubDB table this post references

campaign.description: The GUID of the marketing campaign the post is associated with

enableDomainStylesheets.description: Boolean to determine whether or not the styles from the template should be applied

includeDefaultCustomCss.description: Boolean to determine whether or not the Primary CSS Files should be applied

footerHtml.description: Custom HTML for embed codes, javascript that should be placed before the </body> tag

tagIds.description: The IDs of the tags associated with this post

widgets.description: A data structure containing the data for all the modules for this page

postSummary.description: The summary of the blog post that will appear on the main listing page

headHtml.description: Custom HTML for embed codes, javascript, etc. that goes in the <head> tag

abStatus.description: AB status: master, variant, loser_variant, mab_master, mab_variant, automated_master, automated_variant, automated_loser_variant

useFeaturedImage.description: Boolean to determine if this post should use a featured image

blogAuthorId.description: The ID of the blog author associated with this post

contentGroupId.description: The ID of the post's parent blog

rssSummary.description: The contents of the RSS summary for this Blog Post

url.description: A generated field representing the URL of this blog post

enableGoogleAmpOutputOverride.description: Boolean to allow overriding the AMP settings for the blog

publicAccessRules.description: Rules for require member registration to access private content

archivedAt.description: The timestamp (ISO8601 format) when this Blog Post was deleted

postBody.description: The HTML of the main post body

publicAccessRulesEnabled.description: Boolean to determine whether or not to respect publicAccessRules

currentState.description: A generated ENUM describing the current state of this Blog Post
